title: Reactive Optimizers
abstract: arXiv:2610.33826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a reactive optimizer that uses a pretrained language-model agent to inspect training dynamics and rewrite executable optimizer code during a single training run. The agent can change update rules and schedules for individual parameter groups, without optimizer-specific meta-training or memory transferred from other runs. We evaluate this approach, OPAL, on language modeling and image generation when a recipe has not been tuned for the target setting. Across the evaluated settings, it matches or improves on selected fixed recipes. Analysis of its decisions shows changes to learning-rate schedules, optimizer structure, numerical precision, and momentum. Controlled experiments also show adaptation to repeated data corruption and reduced overfitting. We report these behaviors together with the agent's computational cost and implementation requirements.

translated_abstract: 我们研究了一种反应式优化器，它利用预训练的语言模型智能体来检查训练动态，并在单次训练过程中重写可执行的优化器代码。该智能体可以针对各个参数组修改更新规则和调度计划，无需针对优化器的专门元训练，也无需从其他训练运行中转移的记忆。我们在语言建模和图像生成任务上评估了这种方法（称为OPAL），即在尚未针对目标设置调优训练配方的情况下。在所有评估的设置中，它的表现与选定的固定配方相当或有所提升。对其决策的分析显示，它会修改学习率调度、优化器结构、数值精度和动量。受控实验还表明，它能够适应反复出现的数据损坏，并减少过拟合。我们同时报告了这些行为以及该智能体的计算成本和实现要求。
tldr: 本文提出OPAL，一种利用预训练语言模型智能体在单次训练中实时检查训练动态并重写优化器代码的反应式优化器，在未经调优的设置下可匹配或超越固定优化器配方。
en_tdlr: OPAL is a reactive optimizer that employs a pretrained language-model agent to inspect training dynamics and rewrite executable optimizer code during a single training run, matching or exceeding selected fixed recipes in untuned settings.
